subject: general
question: Who among the following was awarded the 'Grand Prize of the Fukuoka Prize' in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Palagummi Sainath**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Fukuoka Grand Prize for 2021 **has been given to journalist **Palagummi Sainath**.
 
• He is a dedicated journalist who has persisted in looking into India's poor farming villages and documenting the reality of the people who live there.
 
• The Fukuoka City International Foundation and the Japanese city of Fukuoka established the prize, which is granted to people and organisations who seek to preserve Asian culture.
 
• There are two other award categories in addition to the Grand Prize: academics and culture.
 
• **Professor Kishimoto Mio, **a Japanese historian with expertise in the socio-economic history of China during the Ming-Qing dynasty, received the Academics Prize.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Born in Chennai, **Palagummi Sainath** has held positions as vice-editor of the political magazine Blitz and editor of The Hindu.
 
• The journalist received the 1995 Lorenzo Natali Prize for Journalism from the European Commission and the 2000 Amnesty International Global Human Rights Journalism Prize.
 
• In 2001, **he was awarded the Boerma Prize by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, and in 2007,** he was given the Ramon Magsaysay Award for distinguished service to Asian media.

 [IMAGE: https://www.newsclick.in/sites/default/files/styles/amp_1200x675_16_9/public/2022-04/p%20sainath54.png?itok=EopUlhRG] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian historian Romila Thapar **specialises in ancient Indian history, a field in which she is a leader.
 
• **Ramachandra "Ram" Guha** is an Indian historian, environmentalist, author, and public intellectual whose areas of interest include economics, the social and political history of cricket, and historical and present issues related to the environment.
 
• **Ustad Amjad Ali Khan, **an Indian classical sarod player who was born on October 9, 1945, is most renowned for his crisp and quick** ekhara taans. **
